category.reason: The target text, shape, or image is directly visible, and the official ground truth matches the original screenshot; the single primary category follows the actual localization requirement.

instruction.en: Find the Long Yao Road (龙耀路) subway station marker with a metro symbol and a dark red rounded Line 11 badge.
instruction.zh: 找到带有地铁标志、龙耀路站名和深红色圆角“11”号线标记的站点。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. The original description incorrectly placed the metro symbol, 龙耀路 (Long Yao Road) station name, and Line 11 badge inside a white rectangular box and described the badge as a red circle. In the screenshot these elements appear directly on the map without that enclosing white card, and the Line 11 badge is a dark red rounded rectangle. Rewrote instruction.en and instruction.zh to identify the station by its name, metro symbol, and dark red rounded Line 11 badge, removing the inaccurate enclosing-box and circular-shape requirements. The existing groundTruth already identifies the Long Yao Road station marker and was retained.
